title: Introduce request coalescer and decommission legacy aggregator to reduce console backend tail latency
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Console backend periodically experiences high tail latency on routes that fan out to multiple downstream services and GraphQL resolvers. The legacy aggregator component performs synchronous fan-out and per-request serialization that amplifies spikes during traffic bursts. This causes slow UI load times and higher token costs for debug traces. Goal: Replace the monolithic aggregator with a lightweight request coalescer that coalesces identical/nearby queries, batches backend calls where safe, and serves cached rollups for high-cardinality metrics. Scope: - Introduce a request coalescer middleware that deduplicates concurrent GraphQL resolver calls within a short time window (10-50ms) - Replace synchronous aggregator paths with asynchronous, event-driven pipelines for non-critical rollups - Add cache segmentation for user-scoped vs global queries and TTL tuning - Instrument per-route latency and queue-depth metrics and new SLOs - Provide a rollback path by keeping legacy aggregator toggled behind a feature flag Approach: 1) Spike (week 1): microbenchmark coalescer algorithm using synthetic work-stealing queue; evaluate latency/cost trade-offs. 2) Implementation (weeks 2-3): implement coalescer as middleware in backend service, add batching adapters for common downstreams (billing, usage, model-metrics). 3) Gradual rollout (week 4): enable for 10% traffic, observe Grafana SLOs, increase to 100% if stable. 4) Cutover & cleanup: once stable, remove legacy aggregator code and tests. Trade-offs: - Small additional memory consumption to keep in-flight request maps vs reduced downstream load. - Slight complexity increase in resolver plumbing; mitigated by clear interfaces and tests. Success metrics: 30-50% reduction in P95 tail for affected routes, 15% fewer downstream requests, zero customer-facing errors during rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Request coalescer middleware deployed behind feature flag and covered by unit/integration tests
P95 latency for dashboard aggregation routes reduced by >=30% in production canary compared to baseline
Downstream call volume for target endpoints reduced by >=15% when coalescer is active
Monitoring dashboards (Grafana) updated with new metrics: coalesced_requests_total, coalesce_hit_rate, coalesce_queue_depth
Rollback path implemented: legacy aggregator toggle can be re-enabled without a restart
Documentation updated: design doc (Confluence) and developer guide for coalescer integration
